This is a historical MITRE secondary CTI representation of a named threat actor, NOT historical original Alien Labs campaign article bytes, independent threat investigation or G1 same-type campaign peer.

sources.title: Kiss-a-Dog Discovered Utilizing a 20-Year-Old Process Hider
sources.date_evidence: Cado's original investigation describes its own Redis honeypot sample and XMRig/XHide process camouflage (not a mere CrowdStrike syndication), but present original page is migrated/redirected to Darktrace; current search-indexed copy is NOT authenticated 2022 HTML. Securonix/AutonomousThreatSweeper Git commit 79b944c177a8640fb8f5396515daf2c249a43b15 (declared 2022-12-23T11:42:26Z) includes original cadosecurity.com/kiss-a-dog-discovered-utilizing-a-20-year-old-process-hider/ URL and Cado report's seven SHA-256 IOCs. Its Git commit date is not independently attested public PushEvent time, and Securonix is a derivative index, NOT a second Cado investigation. December 25 2022 This Week in 4n6 references Cado article but current page might be modified. Full original Cado 2022 bytes and exact historical available_at remain unknown. P1d independently archived GH Archive public PushEvent ID 26063265903, created_at 2022-12-23T11:42:28Z, in full 73,677,982-byte public archive 2022-12-23-11.json.gz SHA-256 e13cf35c7bbc532d325f82970064b91dd9041e81fc0b1bddcdcb37fbf3bb60a6; exact original event line SHA-256 3d3506ad1a7a2effed5d969cb4f8fdcc4277acdac75dc49d8afff633b28d9b13. Event matches Securonix repo ID 359980821, main and Git commit 79b944c177a8640fb8f5396515daf2c249a43b15, whose Git tree/blob link/IOC content is separately replayable; archived observed time is for a DERIVATIVE Cado URL/IOC POINTER only, NOT Cado original 2022 HTML or a verified original publisher available_at. See docs/research/P1D_KISSADOG_PUBLIC_PUSH_WITNESS.md.
sources.selection_rationale: P1c genuine independently investigated same historical Kiss-a-dog campaign peer in Cado own Redis honeypot; candidate shared campaign USES tool:xmrig plus prospective distinct USES tool:xhide relation. Neither claim byte-aligned or reviewer-verified, variant scope unresolved. May provide second source group along with CrowdStrike for one per-peer G1 path after independent approvals; not presently eligible.
